Lesson Outline & Facilitator Guide

Providing Constructive Feedback

A 60-minute instructor-led session that teaches managers to replace vague praise with specific, actionable feedback using the BEER model — designed for both virtual and in-person delivery.

FormatVirtual (MS Teams) & In-Person
Duration60 minutes
Audience15 virtual / 25 in-person
MethodFacilitated discussion, polling, triad practice
FrameworkBEER Model
01

Design Brief

Purpose

To equip participants with the skills and knowledge to provide effective and constructive feedback.

Learning Objectives

  • Distinguish between praise and constructive feedback.
  • Apply the BEER model to deliver actionable, specific feedback.

Pre-Work

Participants give positive feedback to three people beforehand and reflect on the reactions they observed — priming the room with lived experience before the session opens.

Instructional Approach

Discussion-led throughout, not lecture-led. Concepts are drawn out of the group first via flipchart or Mentimeter poll, then formalized — so participants arrive at the model rather than receive it.

02

The BEER Model

The instructional core of the session. Each letter is taught with a live example, then immediately rehearsed against a video scenario and a real situation participants bring themselves.

B
Behaviour
Describe the specific observed behaviour — what you saw and heard, not an interpretation of it.
E
Effect
Explain the impact of that behaviour on others, on the work, or on you directly.
E
Expectation
Reiterate the standard or outcome that's actually expected going forward.
R
Resolution
Open-ended, collaborative problem-solving on how the issue gets resolved — applies to positive feedback too.
03

Session Run-of-Show

Grouping is deliberately varied across the hour — large group to build shared vocabulary, small group to rehearse it safely, individual to make it personal.

Large Group
Small Group
Individual
TimeContentFormat
2 min Welcome & Introductions

Frame the workshop's purpose and learning objectives.

 Large Group
10 min Feedback: Definition & Purpose

Participants share reactions from the pre-work; group discussion surfaces why feedback matters in performance management.

 Small Group
3 min Defining Feedback

Group builds a working definition of "feedback," reviewed against a formal slide definition.

 Large Group
10 min Feedback vs. Praise

Live flipchart (in-person) or Mentimeter poll (virtual) surfaces the distinguishing characteristics of each.

 Large Group
10 min The BEER Model

Each component introduced with an example; explicitly framed as a tool to enhance feedback, not rush it.

 Large Group
15 min Video & Triad Practice

A short scenario video anchors practice; triads apply the BEER model to build feedback for the employee shown.

 Small Group
8 min Individual Application

Participants draft real feedback for their own situation using the workbook, applying the model to something they'll actually deliver.

 Individual
2 min Wrap-Up & Key Takeaways

Open discussion on the model's utility and the challenges of applying it in practice.

 Large Group
